additions.group: 極小・独立蒸留・late-interaction検索
additions.reason_selected: Independent pretrained and distilled Atto late-interaction learned state, not a quantization. 90.3K nominal FP32 parameters, 32-d token embeddings; distinctive extreme low-resource retrieval tradeoff rather than a new broad task. Preserve as research-only conditional; existing BGE-M3 already has multivector retrieval, so no replacement.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher English 3-set nDCG@10 mean 0.4454 (ArguAna 0.3435, NFCorpus 0.3263, SciFact 0.6663); 840=0.3139, 9K=0.3655; compact learned state.
additions.quality_negative: 950K=0.4816, 4M=0.4818, 25M=0.4995, LateOn 110M=0.5463 on same publisher table; only three datasets, no matched BGE/Qwen/Horizon replay, HW/clock/batch not verified; max sequence 399 and English evidence only; index size, dependency ABI and complete bytes unknown.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Lawful offline retrieval over rights-cleared documents; no safety-bypass criterion. Keep BGE-M3, Qwen embeddings/reranker and Horizon; hold other independent sizes pending matched measurements, do not mistake size variants for quantization. No observed licence/access change in README link correction.
